extra.message: The unauthenticated GET / endpoint accepts the username query parameter and concatenates it directly into Jinja2.from_string(...).render(). Attacker-controlled template expressions are evaluated by the unrestricted Environment created on line 11. This permits server-side template injection, including access to Python objects and arbitrary code execution under the application's privileges.

cwe: CWE-1336: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine

extra.message: HTMLResponse returns attacker-controlled username content as text/html. Line 14 embeds username directly into template source, preserving literal HTML without escaping. A username value of <script>alert(document.domain)</script> therefore executes JavaScript in the application's origin when a victim visits a crafted URL. This requires no template expressions.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
